notes:
- Account: mid-stage legal compliance platform for global investigations and regulatory retention. Heavy archive footprint: ~45M documents across litigation + regulatory data, ~12TB compressed.
- Primary ask: RAG/enterprise search with embeddings + learned reranker. Must support indexing scale (tens of millions of docs) and tight 95th pct latency targets.
- Deployment: VPC-first preference; legal demanded on-prem proof-of-concept for sensitive data. CTO: "No user data may leave our VPC without explicit auditable consent."
- Performance targets: ingest 40-60M docs, support peak 500 qps (search + rerank light path), p95 end-to-end <200ms for typical query, SLA for retrieval latency for e-discovery workflows. Cost sensitivity: want < $0.03 per active query (embeddings + rerank amortized).
- Modeling: plan to generate 1536-dim embeddings for baseline (open model), then run a learned transformer reranker for top-k (k=50) candidate reordering. Interested in Redwood suggestions on quantization (int8/4-bit) and batched KV caching to meet latency/cost goals.
- Security/compliance: 7yr retention for archived records, immutable audit logs, tamper-evident retention proofs, enterprise KMS + HSM integration required, SSO/SAML, SOC2/ISO needs. Data residency: US-only for certain datasets.
- POC scope agreed: 10M doc ingest (subset of contracts + communications), build index, run baseline embeddings + simple cosine, then compare with learned reranker. POC success metrics: 10-15% nDCG improvement vs baseline and p95 rerank latency <120ms.
- Commercial: leaning enterprise reserved capacity or Private deployment. Finance pushing for cost model showing per-query unit economics vs incumbent (Relativity + homegrown vector layer).
- Quotes / call notes: SE noted Redwood Optimize recommendations helpful: "batching + cache reduced our local runs by ~30%" from demo. Legal team flagged retention proof mechanics as decisive.
- Risk: incumbent contract and internal procurement timeline (legal needs fully mapped by May).
